{{Recipe summary
| Category = Soup recipes
| Servings = 2-3
| Time = 30-60 minutes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{Recipe}}

'''Osumade soup''' is a dish native to the Agbor people of Nigeria. It features palm nut extract and osumade (licorice) stick, and it is very aromatic with a sweet flavor. This soup is very light and similar to [[Cookbook:Nsala Soup|nsala soup]].

==Ingredients==
* 2 thumb-sized pieces of [[Cookbook:Liquorice|osumade]] stick, washed
* 1–2 slices of [[Cookbook:Yam|yam]]
* [[Cookbook:Meat and Poultry|Meat]] (any type), washed and cubed
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Seasoning or [[Cookbook:Stock Cube|stock cubes]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Stockfish|Stockfish]]
* 2–3 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Ground Crayfish|ground crayfish]]
* 1 medium ball [[Cookbook:Ogiri|ogili]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Palm Oil|palm oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Dryfish|Dryfish]]

==Procedure==
# Soak the osumade stick in a small bowl of water.
# Peel the soaked osumade stick. Grind it in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] or [[Cookbook:Mortar and Pestle|mortar]], and then sieve it to extract the infused water. Reserve for later.
# Wash the yam, and cut into small pieces.
# Place yam pieces in a medium-sized pot. Cover with water, and cook over medium-high heat until tender. Do not salt at this point.
# Drain the yam. Use a mortar and pestle to pound the yam until it is well-mashed and stretchy.
# Place the meat in a pot. Season with salt, black pepper, and one stock cube. Cook meat over medium-high heat in its own juices
# Cover the meat with water, and bring to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]].
# Add the osumade water, stockfish, ground crayfish, ogili, palm oil, and seasoning cube to the boiling meat. Stir, then cover and cook for 15 minutes. Add additional water as necessary.
# Introduce the pounded yam and the dryfish. Cook for about 5 minutes, or until it reaches the desired consistency.
# Serve the soup with [[Cookbook:Pounded Yam|pounded yam]] or any other [[Cookbook:Swallow|swallow]] of your choice.
